login.noAccount: New here? Create an account. An administrator must approve it before you can use the platform.
login.confirmed: Your email is confirmed. Sign in to continue.

signup.title: Request access
signup.subtitle: Create an account. An administrator must approve it before you can use the platform.
signup.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to your email. Open it, then sign in. After that, an administrator will review your request.

errors.invalid: Enter your full name, a valid email and a password of at least 8 characters.
errors.exists: This email may already be registered. Try signing in.
errors.weak: This password is too weak. Choose a longer or less common one.
errors.unavailable: Sign-up is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

waiting.title: Waiting for approval
waiting.pendingBody: Your account was created. An administrator will review it and assign your role and class. You will get access as soon as it is approved.
waiting.rejectedBody: Your request was not approved. Contact your administrator if you think this is a mistake.
waiting.suspendedBody: Your account is currently not active. Contact your administrator.

adminUsers.title: Account requests
adminUsers.description: Approve new accounts and assign a role and class.
adminUsers.noClasses: No class exists yet. Create one in Supabase (or run the seed) before approving users.

results.error: That action failed. Check the details and try again.
results.unverified: This email is not verified yet, so it cannot be approved.
